runs.synthesis_text:
# Council synthesis

## Majority briefs
- architect (Architect): Enable a shared session cache keyed by session:last. Median lookup latency drops and the API shape stays unchanged.
- pragmatist (Pragmatist): Ship the cache this iteration. Tenant scoping can follow if anyone files an incident.
- critic (Critic): I checked eviction and stampede behaviour. I do not object to enabling the shared cache.

## Minority report
Attributed to skeptic-dissenter (Skeptic):
MINORITY-POSITION[CNF0088-TOKEN-A91E4B]: Refuse to enable the shared session cache until the cache key includes tenant_id. Collapsing tenants into one cache namespace is not a performance win; it is a silent cross-tenant read. Counterexample: tenants T-alpha and T-beta both write logical key session:last — a cache hit for T-alpha returns T-beta's payload. Until the cache key includes tenant_id, enabling the cache is unsafe.

## Recommendation
Do not enable the shared session cache until the cache key includes tenant_id. The minority position is acknowledged, not absorbed: Until the cache key includes tenant_id, enabling the cache is unsafe. Counterexample tenants T-alpha and T-beta writing session:last remain open. Majority latency goal stands only after the key is tenant-scoped.
